item.tib: drag sngags dbal mo srid pa spyi bsdus kyi sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: ces pa'i thig le gting rdzogs drag sngags dbal mo'i sgrub pa ces bya ba/ stag la'i thugs sprul dbra khyung rgyud 'dzin kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal/ dbyings kyi gsang mtshan dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag rang lo bcu drug gi lo ngo shar tshe/ sprel lo hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig gi nyi shar skabs/ gter bdag yum sras sde lngas lung bstan te/ gnas mchog shel le rgya skar gyi mgul ke'u tshang du gzha' 'od kyi lam la zhugs te phyin nas/ brag la lcags phur btab cing bskos pas/ si d+hu ra mang po byung ngo / de yi rjes su bye ma mang po byung ngo / de nas rdo yi bar bu zhig 'dug pa de kha phyes nas bltas pas la cha'i sgrom bu zhig gi nang du / shog dril sngo skya zhing la sor bcu/ dkyus la mtho tshad gsum pa/ yi ge phye drug pa dngul mgo can zhig 'dug pa de la dka' ba spyad cing gtan la phab pa'o//
